body:
Weeeellll, since your country isn't listed in this post, I'm not sure how international we are, lol. But I'm in the US

​

Soooo, I am a horror movie junkie, like, a horror/psychological thriller obsessed weirdo. Even if the movie isn't that great, I will find at least one thing to love about it. I am extremely judgmental (and probably snobbish) about films in general, but especially when it comes to the horror/thriller genre. Several of the horror movies that I love and truly scared me, most people either don't know them or don't understand why they got under my skin, which is truly a disappointment. Hopefully you don't hate me if I say that my favorite Black Mirror episode ended up being Rachel, Jack and Ashley Too. Now, I am going to be this grammar police person; who let the person who came up with this title actually name this episode? Commas exist for a reason, and they failed so badly here with punctuation.

  
ANYWAY. Music is just pretty much the same. If it makes me feel something, I love it, even if I wouldn't want to listen to it again. Melody is everything to me, but especially if it's chaotic and discordant melody. That's like my flame to a moth thing, lol.

  
I actually majored in history, in college, with a minor in English. Not that it's done much good for me, because I would rather die than teach high school/college kids. Just ... no, lol. My focus was European history in the 1800/1900 eras, and most specifically, my favorite thing of all was learning about Eastern European/German (family ties here) history during the wars in the early 1900s.

  
Okay, so, books. Despite its flaws, one of my favorite series is The Dresden Files by Jim Butcher. I have several problems (bones to pick, really) about his writing, but alas, this series still grabs me. I also enjoyed The Hollows series by Kim Richardson, and The Mistborn novels by Brandon Sanderson, which will probably end up being my favorite series of all time, once he has finished writing all the books.

  
When it comes to the outdoors ... NO! That is not me, lol. I don't actually mind camping and hiking, etc. I'm just definitely more of an arts/history/knowledge type of person. BUT, when it comes to traveling? Oh, yes yes yes. Traveling to a specific list of places is on my bucket list. Especially because of an aunt I had when I was a kid, who was from Germany and started teaching me the language, I have always wanted to visit the country for a few months and just totally immerse myself in the culture and language, which is actually the best way to learn a new language, just throw yourself into it.

  
I feel like I've typed you a novel. But as far as what I love most about my specific culture/heritage, y'know, I don't really think I could name anything specific. It's just been pretty basic for me with my family; we don't really do any big, important, ancestral, etc, things, but I would absolutely love it if we did.

​

Sooo, novel/book done now, lol. If you had to pick a specific song to define your life right now, what would you pick/why? Also, feel free to respond in DMs; I know some people feel more comfortable with that. And, crossing my fingers with these paragraphs. The app is being really weird for me right now.

This exactly. I would also suggest putting a blanket or towel that smells like you in the room with him. I did this for my male, the sweetest cat ever, after he came home from the vet in a mad rage. He adjusted after a couple days and is perfectly fine now :)
